name: linguaworld
description: LinguaWorld — A Mandarin-learning platform with an embedded Godot game

scripts.build:vercel: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@linguaworld/web && node scripts/prepare-vercel.mjs
scripts.build:cloudflare-pages: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@linguaworld/web
scripts.db:push: node database/prisma/dbProvider.mjs prepare && prisma db push --schema=./database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: node database/prisma/dbProvider.mjs prepare && prisma migrate dev --schema=./database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:seed: node database/prisma/seed.mjs && node database/prisma/seed_rpg_phase2.mjs && node database/prisma/seed_regions.mjs
